programme.title: I was the king – Grzegorz Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Grzegorz Lato won the top scorer's crown twice in the colors of Stal Mielec in the then 1st league, in 1973 and 1975. He was also the top scorer in the 1974 World Cup. After finishing his football career, he became a coach and later the president of the Polish Football Association (2008-2012). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.desc: «Football according to Raúl (1): Almost Champions» It is often said that we only remember the champion, that no one remembers the runner-up. But there are teams that, due to their trajectory and their way of falling, have gone down in history despite not lifting the trophy. This is the case of Espanyol in the 1988 UEFA, which lost on penalties against Bayer Leverkusen, and of Alavés in the 2001 UEFA, which was defeated 5-4 by Liverpool with a golden goal in its own goal. Raúl tells us the story of those two modest teams that, against all odds, reached their first European final, eliminating the greats of Europe. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Will they be able to help him walk again?This 12 part documentary series will show which animals actually live in the city, and what kind of trouble they encounter. programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1 «Secret Life of the Koala»…Despite being one of Australia's best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviours vary in these different regionsPerhaps Australia's most iconic creature of all, these cuddly looking little characters can face surprising challenges, and in different parts of Australia the koalas have very different stories. Meet Jimmy, a little koala who is trying to find a new home range in the dense woodlands of New South Wales; the koalas at Moreton Bay in Queensland whose population is being monitored; and the koalas of Cape Otway in Victoria, who are overeating their own food supplyDirector: Ashley Davies, Phil StebbingCast: Virge Gilchrist

programme.title: Animal Empires: Sanctuary (S1 E5). Documentary about nature. USA, 2016. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep5 «Animal Empire»…There's strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it's the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundariesAnimals congregate in places where their basic needs can be met: havens from predators where competition for food is manageable and breeding opportunities are abundant. Journey to the habitats of these one-of-a-kind animals and learn their survival stories, from nesting fairy penguins, to migrating caribouDirector: Bob Daly, John Wesley ChisholmCast: Martin Yap

programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep5 «Land of Primates»…Geladas are only found among the peaks and plateaus of Ethiopias Simien Mountains, an ancient range of incredible beauty and biodiversity. We follow the Mountain Band of Geladas as they make their daily migration from the cliff edge to the mountaintopThis fascinating documentary series takes a close look at some of our closest relatives in the animal kingdom: the primates. Explore the characteristics, lifestyles and personalities of these resilient creatures as they face daily challenges in their quest for survival. The film crew visist Madagascar, home to several species of lemur, some found nowhere else on the planet, and we examine how they have adapted to the habitat of this unique island. In the heart of South Africa, an alpha male baboon has to protect his family from a dangerous rival gang. The Semien region of Ethiopia is home to geladas, mountain primates who overcome the difficulties of their rocky home. In Zanzibar, the colobus monkey face the threat of being hunted to extinctionDirector: Claudio Velazques-Rojas, Jordan-Laine Calder

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. programme.title: TRUY TÌM BÍ DANH SỐ 0 - THE COMEBACK
programme.desc: Chú Hứa là một đặc vụ đã nghỉ hưu, chủ một cửa hàng đồ cổ trên phố cổ. Một ngày nọ, khi con phố cũ bị Green Dragon Gang địa phương buộc phải phá bỏ, danh tính ẩn giấu của chú Hua vô tình bị tiết lộ và ông bị truy đuổi bởi một tổ chức bí ẩn do Ah Jie đứng đầu. Một cuộc đấu tay đôi chí mạng vừa mới bắt đầu!

programme.title: CỖ MÁY CHIẾN ĐẤU - THE FIGHT MACHINE
programme.desc: Hai chàng trai trẻ người Canada đến từ những thế giới hoàn toàn khác nhau đang bị mắc kẹt trong một cuộc sống ngoài tầm kiểm soát của anh. Khi họ bị kéo vào vòng chiến đấu tay không không thể tha thứ dưới lòng đất, sự va chạm của họ đã khơi dậy một hành trình báo thù, trả thù và khám phá bản thân tàn bạo.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS

Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH - THE GREY MEN

Sau khi được thả, Shan giúp Tian nổi lên trong băng đảng và trở thành ông chủ mới. Tuy nhiên, khi Shan trấn áp băng nhóm này, anh phát hiện ra một bí mật gây sốc về Tian...
